items.stem: Why is a [Co(NH3)6]3+ complex typically low-spin?

options.text: Ammonia is a strong-field ligand that produces a large d-orbital splitting
options.rationale: Correct: a large splitting favours pairing, giving low spin.

options.text: Ammonia is a weak-field ligand with small splitting
options.rationale: Weak-field ligands favour high spin, which is not observed here.

options.text: The charge alone determines spin state regardless of ligand
options.rationale: Ligand-field strength, not charge alone, sets the spin state.

items.explanation: Correct: a large splitting favours pairing, giving low spin.

items.stem: Which TWO factors raise the lattice energy of an ionic solid? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Higher ionic charges on the constituent ions
options.rationale: Correct: lattice energy scales with the product of the charges.

options.text: Smaller interionic distance between the ions
options.rationale: Correct: smaller separation increases electrostatic attraction.

options.text: Larger ionic radii for both ions
options.rationale: Larger ions increase separation and lower lattice energy.

options.text: Lower ionic charges on the ions
options.rationale: Lower charges reduce the attraction and lattice energy.

items.explanation: Correct: lattice energy scales with the product of the charges.
